set.pl: Dodd Road (Jefferson Highway), Mendota Township / West St Paul line; farm not placed

tw-mn-west-st-paul-rechenberg-jar-1924.t: The finder was a truck farmer on the Jefferson Highway (Dodd Road) in Mendota Township in 1920-1930, renting in 1920 and owning by 1930; the farm tract is still being sought on the Dakota County plats.
src: US census 1920 and 1930, Mendota Twp, Dakota Co., MN (Herman Rechenberg household)
